comparators.candidate: candidate checkout, version 2, same frozen input/config
comparators.policy: candidate native and significance survivors before/after pure ordering

cohort_rules.development_holdout: Before candidate outputs, join captured leagues sharing any initiating/counterparty manager; sort component hashes, assign every third to holdout; one component is evidence-limited
cohort_rules.diagnostic_panel: Before candidate outputs, choose smallest full input hash within each selected-outlook/scoring-format stratum, plus all heldout and constructed cases; preserve full capture inventory and exclusion counts
cohort_rules.repeated_request_hash: deduplicate identical frozen input, retain count
cohort_rules.counterfactual_copies: sensitivity only, not independent observed contexts
cohort_rules.synthetic: constructed correctness probes, no observed acceptance
cohort_rules.confidence_intervals: no causal or outcome CI without eligible cohort and independent clusters
